records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

Only engagement was a bug report (tick_e6732545ee41, now closed); Victor never replied to onboarding outreach [email:8172a8aa] or the fix note [email:0b5c837e]. Starter, single admin, 8 days left. Silent, non-building accounts rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: Getting your first project started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Glad the notification badge issue is sorted on our side after Tariq's fix "We've fixed it on our end" " " if anything still looks off there, just say the word and I'll pick it back up.

Since then I haven't seen a first project in your account yet. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's usually the best first step. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything about getting your team set up.

Best,
Chidi
